title: Economía y dependencia
goal: Read how dollar diplomacy, US corporate control of key industries, and foreign debt created a form of economic dependency that often didn't require troops or formal occupation.

items: Explain what dollar diplomacy meant under President Taft.
Describe which sectors US companies came to control.
Explain the link between single-export economies and vulnerability.
Explain how unpaid debt led to US control of customs offices.
Use cuanto más... (tanto) más to link two growing quantities.
